name: Spiral Rosette
description: Concentric rings stacked and rotated around a single center, tracing a rosette like a plotted spiral.

code.style: --rule: ( @place-cell: center; @size: calc(100% - (100% / @size) * @i); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(calc(@i * 8deg)); border: 1px solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); opacity: calc(.35 + .65 * (@i / @size)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
